verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships a beta Agent Management API that can create, discover, update, and delete Agents, manage agent files and Skills, and authenticate machine clients via OIDC identities. A probe also found an OpenAPI spec published at librechat.ai/openapi.json. The documented surface is beta and limited to agent management, with no evidence that conversations or chats can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: GA-status API, documented endpoints for sending messages and running conversations, an API reference describing the spec's contents, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
